source_event.summary: Independent audit found local delivery-state, deduplication and post-outbound state-truth gaps; the post-CI refreeze revalidated those controls on the new material head.

generalized_learning.reason: The governing provider-call and conversational-flow skills already require outbound-attempt truth, authenticated callback correlation, persisted state, idempotency and concurrency controls. The CI fixes changed only TypeScript type portability, so existing generic controls remain sufficient and were revalidated.
